description: Schedule a Content Studio draft to publish to LinkedIn, or publish it immediately. Set publish_at to 'now' (publish right away), 'next-slot' (the next free slot in the user's posting schedule), or an ISO-8601 timestamp. A timezone (IANA, e.g. 'America/New_York') is required unless publish_at is 'now'. Requires a paid Creator/Lifetime plan.

id.description: The id of the draft to schedule or publish

publish_at.description: When to publish: 'now', 'next-slot' (next free posting slot), or an ISO-8601 timestamp

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Required unless publish_at is 'now'.

name: schedule_post
